reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per plan and month with revenue
  SELECT s.plan_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
    AND p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY s.plan_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE)
)
SELECT plan_name, month, revenue_eur,
  SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY plan_name ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ytd_revenue_eur
FROM monthly

)

solver.query: WITH d AS (SELECT s.plan_name, CAST(date_trunc('month', py.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS month, SUM(py.amount_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM payments py JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = py.subscription_id WHERE NOT COALESCE(py.refunded, FALSE) AND CAST(py.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT plan_name, month, revenue_eur, SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY plan_name ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ytd_revenue_eur FROM d
